title: Studio publish sheet: a batch of hooks reads "3 items · 3 hook" (zh-CN "hook 3"), because hook has no count row and falls back to the raw type name
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGDmSYVyFomEEAdU3

Filing gate: ① user-visible UX defect, stable and with a named landing point (reach: the Studio publish sheet's summary line and group heading after authoring hooks in the Hooks tab).
Business reason: hooks are authored from Studio's own Hooks tab, so every author who publishes them sees an untranslated, unpluralised type code where every other Studio type reads as a word ("3 flows", "3 个流程"). In a zh-CN console the line mixes in the English code.
Reader who acts: `domain:ui`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx` (`TYPE_COUNT`, L832) and the `preview.changes.typeCount.*` keys in the locale packs.
Dedupe (open and closed): `publish sheet "hook"` 37 hits (run records and Studio cards), `TYPE_COUNT` 1 (#29704, closed, which added the row family and kept the raw fallback for types with no row), `DraftChangesPanel` 30.

QA-source: #29893 · studio-authoring.hooks-tab-authoring · observed beside the clauses

## What happens

Measured at framework `589049b0` with the Console built from the same tree, as admin: author three hooks on an object of a writable package in Studio's Hooks tab, then click **Publish**. The sheet's summary reads **"3 items · 3 hook"** and the group heading the same.

**Expected:** "3 hooks" (and the zh-CN pack's own wording), like the other Studio types.

## Mechanism (read at 589049b0)

`TYPE_COUNT` (`DraftChangesPanel.tsx` L832–848) has rows for object, view, page, dashboard, app, action, report, flow, permission, agent, email_template and object_extension. A type with no row goes to `summaryTypeSegment`'s raw `{{n}} {{type}}` fallback (zh: `{{type}} {{n}}`), by design for unknown types (#13147 comment above it). `hook` is a type Studio itself authors, so it should have a row; the owner may want to check the other types the publish door batches (for example `dataset`, `picklist`, `translation`) in the same pass.
